facts.fact: Africa Business Insight (2026-05-25) states that Cameroon is connected to five submarine cable systems, without naming them or their landing stations.

systems.system: Central African Backbone fibre link Cameroon-CAF

systems.owner: Central African Digital Development Agency with MTN Group

note: Article is about CAF; only the Cameroon cable count is a fact for CMR, and the CAF-Cameroon link is CAF's route.
